candaggāha.p: [Canda+gāha] (pu) Google Translate Capture of the moon - Rahu - Asurain - capture; Catching a rotten husband; Lunar eclipse လ ကျတ် ခြင်း. See original candaggāha Sandaggaha (n) [Sandaggaha + na] The art of predicting the eclipse of the moon. Eclipse Prophecy

K:
candaggaha：စန္ဒဂ္ဂဟ （ပု）
[စန္ဒ+ဂဟ။ （စန္ဒြဂြဟ，စန္ဒြဂြဟဏ-သံ）]
လကို-ရာဟု-အသုရိန်-ဖမ်းယူသောအခါ၊ လင်ပုပ်ဖမ်း-လကြတ်-လကျစ်-သောအခါ။

candaggāha：စန္ဒဂ္ဂါဟ （ပု）
[စန္ဒ+ဂါဟ]
လကို-ရာဟု-အသုရိန်-ဖမ်းယူခြင်း၊ လင်ပုပ်ဖမ်းခြင်း၊ လကြတ်ခြင်း၊ လကျစ်ခြင်း။ မူရင်းကြည့်ပါ။

candaggāha：စန္ဒဂ္ဂါဟ （န）
[စန္ဒဂ္ဂါဟ+ဏ]
လကြတ်မည်ကို-ဟော-ပြော-သိ-နိုင်သော အတတ်၊ လကြတ်ဟောအတတ်။
R:
candaggaha：စန္ဒ-ဂ္ဂဟ （ပ）
လကျစ်ခြင်း။ လကြတ်ခြင်း။ လကို ရာဟုဖမ်းခြင်း။

candaggāha：စန္ဒ-ဂ္ဂါဟ （န）
လကြတ်တွက်နည်းဖြင့် ဟောသော ကျမ်း။
DOP: canda m. [ S. candra], 1. the moon ; Abh 51 (indu ~o ca nakkhattarājā); Vin I 246, 35* (nakkhattānaṃ mukhaṃ ~o); D III 185, 2 (nihīyati kāḷapakkhe va ~o); M III 276, 14 (ūno nu kho ~o puṇṇo nu kho ~o ti); A I 215, 7* (~o ca suriyo ca ubho sudassanā); Sn 465 (ye vītarāgā … ~o va Rāhugahaṇā pamuttā); 598 (~aṃ yathā khayātītaṃ pecca pañjalikā janā vandamānā namassanti); Pv 12:7 (yathā pi dārako ~aṃ gacchantaṃ anurodati evaṃsampadam ev’ etaṃ yo petaṃ anusocati); 18:6 (~ato sasam icchāmi); Thī 87 (aggiṃ ~aṃ ca sūriyaṃ ca devatā ca namassi ’haṃ); 384 (~aṃ kīḷanakaṃ gavesasi); Ja III 52, 6 (bodhisatto ākāsaṃ oloketvā ~aṃ disvā sve uposathadivaso ti ñatvā); 154, 6* (udeti āpūrati veti ~o); IV 162, 3* (tipañcarattūpagatamhi ~e vego mahā hohiti sāgarassa, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee tipañcarattūpagamamhi ~o); VI 278, 17* (passa ~aṃ ca suriyaṃ ca obhāsante catuddisā Sineruṃ anupariyante); Ap 419, 26 (~amhi sasakaṃ yathā); Cp 1:10:4 (uposathamhi divase ~aṃ disvāna pūritaṃ); Mil 388, 30 (~o nisāya carati); Vism 418, 6 (candamaṇḍalaṃ pātubhavati, te taṃ disvā … amhākaṃ chandaṃ ñatvā viya uṭṭhito, tasmā ~o hotū ti ~o tv ev’ assa nāmaṃ karonti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee chando hotū ti chando …); Sadd 380, 20 foll. (~o ti somo, so pi candayati hilādayati sītaguṇasampattiyā attano pabhāya sattānaṃ pariḷāhaṃ vūpasamento sukhaṃ uppādetī ti ~o ti vuccati, atha vā dippati siriyā virocatī ti ~o, āgamaṭṭhakathāsu pana chandaṃ janetī ti ~o ti vuttaṃ); — ifc see aḍḍha- ( sv aḍḍha 1 ), nava- ( sv nava 1 ), paripuṇṇa- ( sv paripūrati ), puṇṇa- ( sv pūrati ); — 2. the god of the moon, Canda; D II 259, 23* (Candassūpanisā devā ~am āgu purakkhatvā); Ja V 383, 12 (putto pi ’ssa tath’ eva dānaṃ datvā ~o hutvā nibbatti); Sv 710, 35 (~o nāma devaputto); As 318, 4 (maṇi-mayaṃ rajatapaṭicchannaṃ ekūnapaṇṇāsayojanāyāma-vitthāraṃ ~assa devaputtassa vimānaṃ canda-maṇḍalaṃ nāma, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee sovaṇṇamayaṃ); Sadd 148, 25 foll. (~o maṇimayavimāne vasatī ti ādisu Candadevaputto ~o ti vutto); — °’- attharaka , m. a rug patterned with moon-shapes ; Ps III 18, 12 ( in cpd : assattharakasīhattharaka-vyagghattharakacandattharakasuriyattharaka-, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce -kañcanattharakasuriy-; Ps-ṭ [ Be ] III 10, 15 foll. : assattharakasīhattharakādayo pi assasīharūpādivicittā eva attharakā) = Spk III 45, 4 ( Be, Se so; Ce -kañcanatthara-suriy-; Ee -kacanattharakasuriy-); — ° ânugata , mfn. , following, accompanying the moon ; Ap 533, 13 (bhikkhuniyo jinaggaṃ tārā va ~ā Sumeruṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katva); — °’- ābhā ( and °-r-ābhā), f. [canda + ābhā 1 ], radiance of the moon; moonshine ; A II 139, 16 (catasso imā bhikkhave ābhā … ~ā suriyābhā aggābhā paññābhā); Ja I 474, 9* (~aṃ suriyābhaṃ ca yo ’dha paññāya gādhati; 474, 11´ : ~an ti odātakasiṇaṃ dasseti); Dhp-a IV 191, 3 (satthā … ~āya antaradhānaṃ akāsi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~-antaradhāyanaṃ); Sadd 688, 6 foll. (gāthāvisaye candasaddassa sabbass’ eva candara icc ādeso hoti vā ābhāsadde pare: atibhonti na tass’ ābhā candarābhā satārakā [ quoting Ap 72, 17 : Be, Ce, Se candasūrā satārakā; Ee candasurāsatārakā] ettha ca candarābhā ti ~ā. ~ā ti ca idaṃ sakkaṭabhāsābhāvaṃ patvā dakārarakāra-saññogavasena tiṭṭhati, Māgadhabhāsattaṃ pana patvā candarābhā ti visuṃ tiṭṭhati); — °- kanta , m. [canda + kanta 1 ], the moonstone ; Mil 118, 21 ; — °- ggāha , m. [canda + gāha 2 ], an eclipse of the moon ; D I 10, 21 (evaṃvipāko ~o bhavissati; Sv 95, 6 : ~’-ādayo asukadivasaṃ Rāhu candaṃ gahessatī ti vyākaraṇavasen’ eva veditabbā); Ja I 374, 9´ ; Mil 178, 18 ; — °- nissitaka , mfn. , attached to, supported by, Canda; Sv 690, 12 (~ā devā); — °- maṇḍala , n. , the disc of the moon ; Vin V 121, 2 (~aṃ vivaṭaṃ virocati no paṭicchannaṃ) ≠ A I 283, 6 ; Ja I 253, 29 (pācīnalokadhātuto paripuṇṇaṃ ~aṃ uṭṭhahi); III 55, 25 (pabbataṃ pīḷetvā pabbatarasaṃ ādāya ~e sasalakkhaṇaṃ ālikhitvā); Sp 119, 26 (~aṃ ekūnapaññāsayojanaṃ); 828, 27 (yāne vā hatthi-assapiṭṭhe vā ~e vā suriyamaṇḍale vā nisīditvā); Ps II 159, 8 (āyasmā Puṇṇo Sāriputtatheraṃ ~aṃ āhacca ṭhapento viya ukkhipi); — °- lekhā , f. , a digit of the moon ;? the crescent moon ;? Ap 533, 12 (pabhātakāle vyasanaṃ gahānaṃ disvāna niyyāti va ~ā, Ce so; Ee hi ~ā; Be, Se byasanaṅ-gatānaṃ); Vism 168, 8 ; (divā suriyappabhābhibhavā … vijjamānā pi ~ā aparisuddhā hoti); Dhp-a I 408, 3 (gagana-tale ~ā viya paññāyamānā); — °- vatika , °-vattika, mfn. [ cfS. cāndravratika and cāndrāyaṇa?], one who has vowed to behave like the moon; acting in the manner of the moon, eating less food each day as the moon wanes ;? ( None ;?) Nidd I 89, 24 (~ā vā honti suriyavatikā vā honti indavatikā vā honti, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se °-vattikā); — °- vidu , m ( fn )., (one) who knows the grammar of Cāndra;? Sadd 379, 30 (khidi avayave ti ~uno vadanti, tesaṃ mate khindatī ti rūpaṃ, perhaps wr; cf Cāndra-Dhātupāṭha I 22 √bidi); — °- vimāna , n. [canda + vimāna 1 ], the palace or vehicle of the god of the moon, ie the moon ; Ps III 76, 15 (~assa anto pavisitvā); Spk I 109, 3 (~aṃ suriyavimānaṃ vā); Sadd 148, 30 (cando ti ca candimā ti ca Candadevaputtassa pi ~assa pi nāman ti veditabbaṃ); 793, 20 (candasaṅkhāto devaputto asmiṃ vijjatī ti candimā, ~aṃ); — °- sama , ( mf ) n. [canda + sama 3 ], (what is) like the moon ; Ja VI 232, 10* (kena vā vikalaṃ tuyhaṃ khippaṃ abhiharantu te mano karassu kuḍḍamukhī api ~amhi pi, Ce, Ee so; Be kiṃ khippaṃ āharanti te; Se kiṃ khippaṃ ahiharanti te; 232, 24´ : ~amhi pī ti candato dullabhataro nāma natthi, tādise pi ruciṃ katvā mamācikkha, sampādessāmi te ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr candanā dullabhataro); — °- savhaya , mf ( n )., called Canda; Cp 1:7:1 (kumāro ~o; Cp-a 58, 4 : ~o ti candasaddena avhātabbo, candanāmo ti attho) quoted Sadd 456, 18 ; — °- sūra , m. [canda + sūra 2 ], the sun and moon; representations of the sun and moon ; Ap 2, 2 (~ehi maṇḍitā, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se °-suriyehi; Ap-a 105, 13 : ~ehi °-sūriyarūpehi ca maṇḍito so pāsādo ti attho, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee °-suriyehi); 72, 17 (abhibhonti na tass’ ābhā ~ā satārakā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee atihonti hi tass’ ābhā candasurāsatārakā); 541, 24 (satārā ~ā ca lañchitā kanakāmayā, Be, Ee so; Ce °-suriyā; Se °-surā); — see also acandamullokika, candama(s), candima(s), maṇicandaka ( sv maṇi ).
